title: IPU documents on a crash that killed Sandia technicians
summary: UAPGerb tells of IPU documents on a crash that killed Sandia technicians, about late 1940s at Sandia National Laboratories, Albuquerque, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: IPU documents later because that actually talks about like a crash retrieval um that killed technicians at Sandia National Labs because of the danger of the crash.

plain: An online UFO researcher who goes by UAPGerb points to a set of papers he calls the IPU documents, which he groups with the Majestic documents, papers said to come from a secret government group dealing with UFOs. He says they describe a crash retrieval, meaning the recovery of a crashed unknown craft, in the late 1940s that killed technicians at Sandia National Labs, a US government research laboratory in New Mexico, because the crash itself was so dangerous. If true, it would mean the government recovered such a craft and that people died handling it.
